samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage bucket configured with 'allUsers' having 'roles/storage.objectViewer' role, resulting in public read access to proprietary marketing materials.

technical_data.sample_http_get_request:

User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Accept: image/png

relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: AWS S3 bucket policy misconfigured to allow 's3:*' actions to everyone, leading to unauthorized write and read access on development environment backups.

technical_data.sample_http_put_request:
PUT /dev-backups/injected/malicious_script.sh HTTP/1.1
Host: dev-backups.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com
User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
Content-Type: application/x-sh
Content-Length: 2345

#!/bin/bash
echo 'Malicious code execution' > /tmp/malicious.log

samples.detection_method: Automated scanning of bucket policies for overly permissive "Principal": "*" with wildcard s3 actions; monitoring CloudTrail for PutObject and DeleteObject events from anonymous users; alerting on unexpected files uploaded to backup buckets.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
